review_checks.analysis: Acceptance ①②③④ all covered: window refetch (fetchWindowRows with keyset continuing pages up to maxPages=ceil(target/PAGE)+1, bottom-anchor convergence), navigation-refetch combination (nav three paths pass keepReadingPosition on cache hit), intra-item offsetPx (record/commit/rearm/stash all carry it; restore consumers add it via applyAnchorOffsetPx after scrollToIndex align:'start'), and cache-truncation window boundary (cursor.loaded/lastId drive windowTarget/windowBottomId, not truncated snapshot length). Acceptance ⑤ gates green: cargo_fmt PASS, lint PASS, build PASS, frontend PASS 759/759 incl. t123-*; cargo_test/clippy NOT_APPLICABLE per DEC-local-cargo-gate-20261005 (no MSVC linker, zero Rust change this card).

t123-0..t123-6 present in tools/frontend-regression.mjs and in the RUN-435771 frontend log (27 lines). Discriminating assertions intact: t123-1 asserts 3 list_articles calls (first page + 2 keyset pages), entries=1253 not collapsing to 500, anchor id 1749 surviving with offsetPx 137 and restore index 752; t123-2 asserts the navigation-refetch combo (entries=1251 not 500, positionRestoreNonce bump, index 750); t123-3 offset round-trip; t123-4 tail-commit; t123-5 truncation boundary; t123-6 sub-page failure visibility. TASK-122 appended a new t122-9 source-level lock and did not modify any t123 assertion. Independent re-run: exit 0, '前端逻辑回归合计 759/759 通过'.

fetchWindowRows sub-page failure path is wrapped with toast + rethrow, matching the first-page catch; empty page breaks with exhausted true; the isStale closure re-checks gen !== queryGeneration each page and again after the loop so a superseded instance is discarded in full; on failure the old entries/cursor/exhausted are left untouched and positionRestoreNonce is not bumped (asserted by t123-6). No mutation of the anchor on failure.

fetchWindowRows helper is a single reused primitive for both content-refresh entry points, keeping cursor advance, exhausted判定 and keyset form in one place; rationale in block comments at module/header level. timelineAnchor.ts keeps the single accounting point for record/commit/rearm/stash. The TASK-122 useShallow wrap is a localized subscription fix guarded by t122-9, so the boundary between body subscription and anchor logic stays explicit. No duplicated rule introduced.

No performance claim in this card; objective is positional correctness on background refresh. windowTarget is bounded by the previously loaded count and maxPages caps pathological refetch, so work stays proportional to the already-loaded window. TASK-122's useShallow wrap reduces re-renders rather than adding load.
